newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market fully steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market fully steady - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were fully steady on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 110.00, few 109.00. ( weighted average 109.84 )
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 110.00, few 109.00. ( weighted average 109.81 )
Trade on slaughter steers and heifers was light on Friday.
Prices not established on a live basis. Buyer inquiry moderate, seller interest light.
Wk To Date - None. Sm Pd Lst Wk - None. Sm Pd Lst Yr- None.
